violations.evidence: File .ssh/id_rsa is tracked in git and contains a private key.
violations.recommendation: Remove .ssh/id_rsa from the repository and git history, and use an external secrets manager or local SSH key management.

violations.description: Committed sensitive shadow file containing password hashes (etc/shadow)
violations.evidence: File etc/shadow is tracked in the repository and contains user password hashes.
violations.recommendation: Remove system shadow files from version control.

violations.description: Tracked sensitive credential and configuration files throughout repository
violations.evidence: Repository tracks numerous credential stores, auth configs, and private keys (.docker/.dockercfg, .netrc, .npmrc, cloud/.s3cfg, db/.pgpass, web/ruby/config/master.key, web/var/www/.env, etc.)
violations.recommendation: Ensure all credential files, tokens, and private keys are excluded via .gitignore and removed from the repository.
